description: Resource notices: shows disk status and dismisses the current episode. The page's live stream (/api/stream2) reports low disk space (episode 7, 1.6 GB available), and dismissing it is faked; call "dismissals" lists every dismiss request as "<path> episode <episode_id in its body>", one per line, or "none". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. The element with data-testid "disk-notice" (the notice) should be visible (allow 30s). 3. The notice's text should contain "Disk space is low". 4. The notice's text should contain "1.6 GB remaining". 5. The element with data-testid "disk-notice-title" must have the attribute role exactly "status". 6. Call "dismissals": it must return exactly "none". 7. Click the element with data-testid "disk-notice-dismiss". 8. Call "dismissals" until it returns exactly "/api/resources/disk/dismiss episode 7". 9. There must then be exactly 0 elements with data-testid "disk-notice".
